name: qkd_kvs_ctl_c32i-c32i-COMMIT
purpose: Structural replacement after c32g boxed route and deep accept-to-held mux: DSTG=1 registers accepted target strobes and matched payload before write selects. MU GAP validation stays at original edge; complete layer output stages after GAP mux. All boot configuration writes +1 edge; production programme unchanged. Full W/E faces <=3.1 pins/um; wide standard-cell corridors and separated SRAMs, no area squeeze.
